title: Citehound pricing: Scan free, Pro, Fix and Beyond
description: Early-access pricing: Scan is free, Pro is $39 a month, Fix starts at $299, Beyond is $490 a month. Payments open soon. Reserve your spot.
h1: Start free. Pay for the step you need.
sub: Early-access pricing. Payments open soon, reserve your spot.
measure: The free scan measures readiness: whether assistants can reach and trust your site. Pro adds a citation check: ten buyer-style questions asked to {ENGINES}, recording whether your brand is named. A dated sample, one run each; API results can differ from the consumer apps.

tiers.name: Scan
points: The access state of 10 AI crawlers
A copy-paste fix for each failed check

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.priceNote: First month free for the first 10 early-access users
points: Whole-site report: up to 25 pages, page by page
Weekly re-scan with email alerts when something regresses (part of Pro early access)

tiers.line: From $299 · Fixed quote after your scan

faq.a: These are the prices for the first customers. Payments are not open yet. Leave your email through the form on a plan to reserve your spot, and we write to you when it opens. Nothing is charged today.

faq.q: Do Fix and Beyond include Pro?
faq.a: Yes. Fix includes 3 months of Pro. Beyond includes Pro for as long as you stay.
Fix starts at $299. After your scan we send you a fixed quote. Once you agree to it, the price does not change.

Beyond is $490 a month with a 3-month minimum and a limited number of seats. We research the questions your customers ask, analyze the gaps on your pages and write four edited pieces a month. You approve each one before it is published, and we re-measure every month.

faq.q: When do weekly re-scans and alerts start?
faq.a: Weekly re-scans with email alerts are part of Pro early access. They are not running yet. We tell the Pro waitlist when they switch on.

closeTitle: See how AI reads your site first.
closeText: The scan is free and takes about 30 seconds. Then pick a step.
